---
title: Web Map Tile Services(WMTS)
# sidebar_position: 2
---


1. **Introduction** 

   This Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) Implementation Standard provides a standard based solution to serve digital maps using predefined image tiles. The service advertises the tiles it has available through a standardized declaration in the ServiceMetadata document common to all OGC web services.

1. **WMTS using HTTP KVP encoding and Restful**

 **Define path info:**
- `@hostname = http://10.225.0.234`
- `@apipath = /vietbando/api/v1/wmts`
- `@defaultid = geotest (default id capabilities)`

**KVP:**
- **GetCapabilities** is a fundamental operation that allows clients to retrieve information about the available tile sets, layers, styles, and other metadata for a WMTS service. It provides a way for clients to understand what data and operations are supported by the service.
- *URL:*
```
GET:{{hostname}}{{apipath}}/{id}?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities&RESOURCEURL=true
(default RESOURCEURL = false)
```
- *Parameter:*

SERVICE: Service type identifier|Character String type, not empty SHALL be "WMTS".

REQUEST: Operation name|Character String type, not empty SHALL be "GetCapabilities".

RESOURCEURL: Enable/disable the function of creating a Layer containing ResourceUrl,Character String type (RESOURCEURL= true/false).

```
Ex:{{hostname}}/{{apipath}}/vbdmapv3\_OGC?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities
```

- *Illustrating Image:*

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Image 1. GetCapabilities by ID vbdmapv3\_OGC   (Postman)

- **GetTile** is one of the standard operations that allows you to request map tiles from a WMTS server.
- *URL:*
```
  GET:{{hostname}}{{apipath}}/{id}?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=GetTile&VERSION=a.a.a&LAYER=bbb&STYLE=ccc&FORMAT=ddd&TILEMATRIXSET=eee&TILEMATRIX=fff&TILEROW=ggg&TILECOL=hhh
```
- *Parameter*
```
SERVICE: Service type identifier, character String type, not empty SHALL be "WMTS".
REQUEST: Operation name, character String type, not empty SHALL be "GetCapabilities".
LAYER: Layer identifier,c haracter String type.
STYLE: Style identifier,character String type.
FORMAT: Output format of the tile, character String type(image/png).
TILEMATRIXSET: TileMatrixSet identifier,character String type.
TILEMATRIX: TileMatrix identifier, character String type.
TILEROW: Row index of tile matrix, character String type.
TILECOL: Column index of tile matrix, character String type.
VERSION: Version service WMTS support, character String type (1.0.0)
```
```
Ex: {{hostname}}/{{apipath}}/vbdmapv3_OGC?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=GetTile&VERSION=1.0.0&LAYER=mapall&STYLE=normal&FORMAT=image/png&TILEMATRIXSET=EPSG:900913&TILEMATRIX=0&TILEROW=0&TILECOL=0
``` 
- *Illustrating Image:*

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. **GetFeatureInfo:**
- **GetFeatureInfo:** The GetFeatureInfo operation is designed to provide clients of a WMTS with more information about features rendered in a previously returned tile.
- *URL:*
```
  GET:{{hostname}}{{apipath}}/{id}?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=GetFeatureInfo&VERSION=a.a.a&LAYER=bbb&STYLE=ccc&FORMAT=ddd&INFOFORMAT=ffff&TILEMATRIXSET=eee&TILEMATRIX=fff&TILEROW=ggg&TILECOL=hhh&I=iii&J=jjj
```
- *Parameter*
```
SSERVICE: Service type identifier, character String type, not empty SHALL be "WMTS".
REQUEST: Operation name, character String type, not empty SHALL be "GetCapabilities".
LAYER: Layer identifier,c haracter String type.
STYLE: Style identifier,character String type.
FORMAT: Output format of the tile, character String type(image/png).
INFOFORMAT: Output format of the feature, character String type(application/json)
TILEMATRIXSET: TileMatrixSet identifier,character String type.
TILEMATRIX: TileMatrix identifier, character String type.
TILEROW: Row index of tile matrix, character String type.
TILECOL: Column index of tile matrix, character String type.
VERSION: Version service WMTS support, character String type (1.0.0)
J: Row index of a pixel within the tile|Non negative integer type value between 0 and TileHeight-1 of this tile matrix defined in the ServiceMetadata document.
I: Column index of a pixel within the tile|Non negative integer type value between 0 and TileWidth-1 of this tile matrix defined in the ServiceMetadata document.
```
```
Ex: {{hostname}}/{{apipath}}/vbdmapv3_OGC? SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=GetFeatureInfo&VERSION=1.0.0&LAYER=region_vnpark&STYLE=region_vnpark&INFOFORMAT=application/json&TILEMATRIXSET=EPSG:900913&TILEMATRIX=11&TILEROW=960&TILECOL=1635&I=15&J=126
```


- *Illustrating Image:*

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Image 5. GetFeatureInfo by ID vbdmapv3_OGC and LayerID region_vnpark  (Qgis)

**ServerExternal:**
- **ServerExternal** allows adding more Mapnik servers external and use the parameter "SERVERNAME= XXXX" when make the request.
- *Url:*
```

GET : http://{{Host}}:{{WMTSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wmts?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=ServerExternal&NAME={Id}

GET : http://{{Host}}:{{WMTSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wmts?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=ServerExternal

POST : http://{{Host}}:{{WMTSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wmts?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=ServerExternal

DELETE : http://{{Host}}:{{WMTSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wmts?SERVICE=WMTS&REQUEST=ServerExternal&NAME={Id}

```
- *Example body:*
```
{
    "Id": "mapnik_2",
    "Host": "http://10.222.3.82",
    "Port": "8083"
}
```




(\*)Updating and deleting capabilities can be performed when the ID does not exist in the list of capabilities retrieved from the GetListMaps API.
